parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The project description, used for filtering.

parameters.name: fetchQuota
parameters.description: Specifies whether to retrieve the project quota information.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The line from which the query starts. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: projectName
parameters.description: The name of the project. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 100. A maximum of 500 project entries can be returned.
